meta.description: Continue pretraining from an existing KERMT checkpoint. The skill validates the user's checkpoint and pretrain CSV, prepares the data into shard/vocab/features form, then launches pretrain_ddp.py inside the kermt container (detached for long runs). Auto-dispatches pretrain_mode based on the checkpoint type (grover_base vocab-only, cmim, or hybrid).

recommendations.title: Refactor modes and hard rules to reference files
recommendations.problem: 317-line SKILL.md exceeds 250-line target; modes section (48 lines) and hard rules (17 lines) add significant bulk
recommendations.root_cause: Important content kept inline for accessibility but inflates main file
recommendations.fix: Create references/modes.md for detailed fresh-schedule vs resume comparison and references/hard-rules.md for safety constraints; keep 1-2 paragraph summary of each in SKILL.md with pointer to full documentation

recommendations.title: Add GPU indexing diagnostic as workflow step
recommendations.problem: Python command to print torch.cuda device names shown in hardware requirements but not integrated into workflow for users experiencing GPU selection issues
recommendations.root_cause: Diagnostic command mentioned as aside rather than actionable troubleshooting step
recommendations.fix: Add to Common errors section: 'GPU selection not working as expected → run python -c "import torch; print([torch.cuda.get_device_name(i) for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())])" inside container to see torch.cuda enumeration order; use CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES if mismatch'

recommendations.title: Enhance vocab mismatch error guidance
recommendations.problem: Common errors mentions missing prepare outputs from --skip-vocab but doesn't provide specific error message or detailed recovery beyond generic re-run
recommendations.root_cause: Error scenario documented at high level without concrete troubleshooting
recommendations.fix: Expand common errors entry: 'prepare_data manifest is missing required outputs → error shows "vocab_source: null" or missing atom_vocab/bond_vocab/smiles_vocab keys. Recovery: re-run prepare_data.py without --skip-vocab or equivalent flags; ensure --vocab-dir points to directory with all three vocab files'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for repeated runs
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running workflow multiple times with same inputs produces identical or divergent results
recommendations.root_cause: Timestamped run directories prevent overwrites but determinism not documented
recommendations.fix: Add to Hard rules: 'Idempotency: running this workflow multiple times with same checkpoint and corpus creates independent timestamped run directories. If --seed N is consistent and data prep is deterministic, results should be reproducible per cmd_replay; otherwise stochastic variation expected from data shuffling and random initialization.'
